label: Orders
caption: HAMM, COMM’R, AL DOC, ET AL. V. MILLER, ALAN
text: The application to vacate injunction presented to Justice Thomas and by him referred to the Court is granted. The September 19, 2022 order of the United States District Court for the Middle District of Alabama is vacated. Justice Sotomayor, Justice Kagan, Justice Barrett, and Justice Jackson would deny the application to vacate injunction.
